hook: One import switched the GIL back on

beats.say: A CPU-heavy Python service processing thousands of independent records looked ideal for free-threaded Python, and the first test spread work across every core.
Then production dependencies arrived, and the run fell back to one core — a single compiled extension had not declared free-threaded support.
Importing it silently re-enabled the GIL, a reminder that Python 3.15's free-threaded build is a separate runtime, not a switch.
